Harvest Ledger (the most common rival family on 09-30) lengthens this sale look-ahead from 4 to 7 steps when the rival mirrors its farm; do the same against rivals of class mirror (queued by hand 2026-09-30).

guidance: Recommendation 1 (Market Timing & Terminal Cash Realization): In ENGINE PARAMETERS '_SETTINGS', mutate 'terminal_liquidation' from false to true and evaluate flipping 'room_guard' from false to true. The match objective is strictly liquid cash at step 719, and shed inventory held at game end yields zero value; enabling terminal liquidation eliminates unliquidated shed overhang across close-margin losses (where we dropped games by under $50). Concurrently, 'room_guard' safeguards against catastrophic shed overflow (hard-capped at 100 units), preventing unconditional deletion of high-value late harvests (milk, wool, strawberries).

Recommendation 2 (Oracle Guard Execution & Margin Floor): Under ORACLE GUARD PARAMETERS, reduce '_OG_PRICE_RATIO' from 0.75 down to 0.68 - 0.70 while keeping '_OG_ITEMS' strictly pinned to ["MILK", "WOOL", "STRAWBERRY"]. Recent empirical mutations showed that adding melon (noisy forecasts) or egg (margin compression) produces negative net delta, but the current 0.75 price floor is excessively rigid: when opponent dump pressure initiates a price decline, our guard withholds sales, leaving inventory vulnerable to the subsequent price collapse (often down to 0.35-0.40). Lowering the floor to ~0.68 ensures front-running executes before town market liquidity evaporates.

Recommendation 3 (Workforce Productivity & Idle Unit Harvesting): Under KAD COPILOT PARAMETERS, mutate '_KC_JOBS' from ["WATER"] back to ["WATER", "HARVEST"] while holding '_KC_JOB_P' at 0.60 or slightly tightening it to 0.65. Early-game activation shifts (step 96 vs 144) proved completely inert, but in mid-to-late steps, restricting idle hands to watering alone forces workers standing on mature multi-harvest tiles (strawberry, ongoing tomato, or sheep/cows) to output PASS. Enabling high-confidence in-place harvests captures high-margin produce without expending unit movement ticks.

Recommendation 4 (Crop Margin Rationalization & Labor Capital Allocation): In ENGINE PARAMETERS, adjust '_CA_MARGIN' from -22.0 toward -15.0 to -12.0, and raise '_CXTB_MIN_REVENUE' from 7000 toward 8000 - 8500. Mutations diluting high-priority queues with low-value crops proved disastrous (-$3,077), and planting carrots at a margin of -22.0 (on a $35 base crop) squanders labor and land when Pet Cafe demand is absent. Similarly, an overly permissive tomato revenue threshold (7000) commits 10 tiles on days 26-29 during unfavorable town configurations, causing outsized $500-$1000 losses against non-absorptive markets.

Recommendation 5 (Exploiting Known Competitor Profiles): Switch channel 'rival_counter' from off to on, but isolate class-specific parameter tweaks inside 'counters' rather than globally modifying '_OG_ITEMS'. While an earlier attempt failed due to bundle-polluting oracle items with melon and egg, 'rival_emulator' is already successfully fingerprinting ladder opponents (e.g., leo_icefire_0930). Use 'counters' exclusively to adjust margin race gates ('V9_RACE_MARGIN' from 12 to 10) or herd swap thresholds ('_HD2_RATIO') against identified rival engines without destabilizing the baseline against the general replay pool.
